description: List the valid service type categories for a given niche directory. Use this before calling search_providers with a service_type filter to ensure you pass a valid value. Each niche has its own taxonomy — for example, "coated-local" has epoxy, polyaspartic, metallic_epoxy, etc., while "radon-local" has radon_testing, radon_mitigation, ssd_installation, etc.

niche_id.description: Niche ID (e.g. "coated-local", "radon-local"). Get options from list_niches.

name: list_service_types
